title: PonziLand
tagline: A simple simulation of what a ponzi scheme looks like in a persisant and permissionless full on chain game.
description: A Fully on chain Land based ponzi simulation, working with taxe wars and price predictions from the players. When you buy land you must put up a selling price and also a tax deposit, every block a part of that deposit is lost in a form of to your neighbors, the more neighbors you have the more taxe you pay, but the more taxe you collect. Based on this pricing your plots correctly is thewhole challenge of the game. DOn't be too greedy you will loose everythin. But don't be to nice. You won't stay in play for long!
how_its_made: Full on Chain using Mud and React as the framework, the game state is hosted on a smart contract. The whole game state is gathered every block for maximum update speed. It's as real time as possible on the blockchain. The contract uses smart optimisations for the game state, using bit manipulation. Only 2 simple art assets where needed, but the result is very visual and pleasing to the eye.
